summary: Form 6-K filed by Kandal M Venture Ltd reporting a related-party acquisition. Its wholly owned subsidiary Padachi M entered a second agreement to purchase an additional 15% of Dumaine International Ltd for US$2.5 million cash from directors Miao Duncan and Miao Tai Wai, David. Total stake after completion increases to 30%. Consideration was based on an arms-length negotiation and a January 2026 valuation by Moore Transaction Services. The board approved the transaction on June 8, 2026. The filing is a non-US foreign private issuer report; equivalent to a material definitive agreement 8-K. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration risk given the related-party nature.
